statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail risk of 22% sits in the watch band, above the 20% threshold and below the 25% block level.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold while an unfilled gap-up holds the Nasdaq-100 within 0.05% of its session high. Conditions are shallow-retracement rather than violently directional, and the flagged window is narrow: 17:00Z to 20:00Z, covering the 3-year note auction, the Fed Schmid speech and the US cash close.
headline: Nasdaq-100 holds an unfilled gap near record highs; Tail edges into the watch band at 22%
body: The Nasdaq-100 trades at 31,345 (+0.87%) about two hours into the US cash session, with a session range of 31,208-31,361 that leaves the gap above Monday's 31,076 record close unfilled and price within 0.05% of the session high. Cross-assets are aligned risk-on: VIX 15.3 (-1.2%), the 10-year Treasury yield 5.27% (-4bp) and WTI -1.5% at $88.09, with semiconductor leadership from AMD (+3.8%) and Nvidia (+1.1%) and broad participation across the Dow (+0.77%) and S&P 500 (+0.90%). The combination of a sustained gap, holding near the session extreme and a total range of only 0.49% is shallow-retracement structure, which is the pattern most relevant to mean-reversion risk, and it lifts Tail from 19% to 22%. Tail stays below the 25% block level because the advance is modest in magnitude, realised volatility is low and no event catalyst is driving it. Stress remains elevated at 47% on a structural backdrop of 30-year yields near 5.66%, their highest since 2002, and Brent near $98. lookbackSummary: The 24 hours to 14:00Z are fully covered by published Claude assessments. Tail ran 8-20%, with a single WATCH print at 19:00Z on 05 October, then compressed to 8-12% through the Asian session before rising steadily from 13% at 10:00Z to 19% at 14:00Z as the US cash session took hold. Stress eased from 51% to a 45% overnight floor after peaking at 54%, and Confidence held at 86-88% throughout. Mode ran trend-up late on 05 October, mixed overnight, and trend-up again from 10:00Z.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds the watch band through the US afternoon, peaking at Tail 24% in the 19:00Z power hour and easing to 23% at the 20:00Z cash close, then steps down to the low band from 22:00Z as post-cash liquidity thins. Tail bottoms at 13% across the quiet Asian hours, rebuilds with European and US liquidity from 05:00Z, and returns to the 20% watch threshold in the first full US cash hour of 07 October. Confidence decays from 87% to 63% with distance from the evidence cutoff. Mode is trend-up through 21:00Z and mixed thereafter.
